_how: The home page's flavour of the week. Edit this file and deploy; no code changes. All three are optional.
_featured: A line above the newest sets, for example {"label": "New", "text": "Star Trek is out", "href": "/?q=set:trk"}. The link must stay on this site (start with /).
_cards: A search whose results the cards at the bottom of the home page are drawn from, for example "set:trk" for a new set or "t:snow" in winter. Leave empty for cards from anywhere.
_theme: A look for the home page: "" (the usual one), "winter" or "anniversary".
